card.name: Word-start FL- pieces in split words
card.fires_on: The letters FL or fl at the start of a word that is split into pieces, such as flat, fluid, flavored, flukes, flatus, flaps or flare. Often in capitalized label text.

modes.label: Capitalized FL
modes.description: Capital FL starting an all-caps word in label text.
modes.example: INHIBITION OF PERISTALSIS MAY RESULT IN<< FL>>UID RETENTION IN THE COLON,

modes.label: Lowercase fl inside compounds
modes.description: Lowercase fl beginning the second part of a compound or a word like flatus.
modes.example: streams (including intermittent streams), mud<<fl>>ats, sandflats, wetlands

card.writes: It favors continuations like AT or at after FL, and suppresses flat-related words.
card.plain: It spots the start of a word beginning with fl that is split up, especially when it is about to become flat or flatus.
